## Access-Review (Certification) Campaign in ISC — API Flow

The full lifecycle has three phases: **authenticate → create → activate → read results**. Here's each call with the key request/response details.

---

### 0. Authenticate

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={clientId}
&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Exchange a Personal Access Token's `client_id`/`client_secret` for a bearer token. Use `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on all subsequent calls. Rate limit: 100 requests/token/10 s.

---

### 1. Create the Campaign

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 2026 Entitlement Review",
  "description": "Quarterly access certification for all active identities",
  "type": "SEARCH",                   // MANAGER | SOURCE_OWNER | SEARCH | ROLE_COMPOSITION
  "deadline": "2026-08-31T23:59:59Z",
  "emailNotificationEnabled": true,
  "recommendationsEnabled": true,
  "mandatoryCommentRequirement": "REVOCATION",
  "searchCampaignInfo": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "query": {
      "queryType": "SAILPOINT",
      "sailpointQuery": {
        "query": "attributes.department:Engineering"
      }
    },
    "reviewer": {
      "type": "IDENTITY",
      "id": "{reviewerIdentityId}",
      "name": "Jane Doe"
    }
  }
}
```

**Response:** `200 OK` with the full campaign object including `"id"` (the campaign ID) and `"status": "STAGED"`. The campaign is staged but not yet running — reviewers have not been notified.

Key body fields:
| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `type` | Campaign type — `MANAGER`, `SOURCE_OWNER`, `SEARCH`, or `ROLE_COMPOSITION` |
| `deadline` | ISO-8601 due date |
| `searchCampaignInfo` / `sourceOwnerCampaignInfo` / `roleCompositionCampaignInfo` | Type-specific config block |
| `recommendationsEnabled` | Surface AI recommendations to reviewers |
| `mandatoryCommentRequirement` | When comments are required: `ALL_DECISIONS`, `REVOCATION`, or `NO_DECISIONS` |

---

### 2. Activate (Start) the Campaign

The campaign must be in `STAGED` status before this call.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "timeZone": "America/Chicago"   // optional — used for deadline display
}
```

**Response:** `202 Accepted` — ISC queues a background job that generates the reviewer work items (certifications) and sends email notifications. Poll `GET /v3/campaigns` to watch for `"status": "ACTIVE"`.

---

### 3. Poll Campaign Status

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns?detail=SLIM&filters=id eq "{id}"
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Wait until `status` transitions from `STAGED` → `ACTIVE`. The response also includes `totalCertifications` and `completedCertifications` counters you can use as a progress indicator.

---

### 4. Pull In-Progress Results

**4a. Get the campaign-level report metadata** — lists available report types for the campaign:

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Returns an array of report descriptors with `type` (e.g., `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION`, `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS`, `CAMPAIGN_DECISION`), `status`, and a download `task` reference.

**4b. Trigger a specific report run** (if you need a fresh snapshot):

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Replace `{type}` with one of:
- `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION` — who/what is in scope
- `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS` — revocation tracking
- `CAMPAIGN_DECISION` — approve/revoke decisions made so far ← **the results report**

**Response:** `202 Accepted` with a task ID. Poll the task until complete, then download the CSV/JSON report.

---

### Required Scopes Summary

| Call | Scope |
|---|---|
| Create campaign | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| Activate campaign | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| List campaigns (poll status) | `idn:campaign:read` or `idn:campaign:manage` |
| Get/run reports | `idn:campaign-report:read` or `idn:campaign-report:manage` |

Required user level: `ORG_ADMIN` or `CERT_ADMIN`.

---
